header.description: What: CE-6010 (city battle B-0, docs/designs/group-maneuvers/DESIGN_City_Battle_Showcase.md §4c) - the SKELETON of the city battle on the city-battle town (1.5 km): attacker (Friend) from the west fields - A Coy and B Coy (mech-company macros: 3 platoons of 6 squads + 2 M1 + 4 IFV each), the air-assault platoon beside 4 UH-60s (held), A-10 + AH-64 parked (held), mortar section, 2 drone teams, 3 Javelin teams, an engineer squad + the bulldozer, HQ and jammer HMMWVs; defender (Hostile) - 1/2/3 Coy (defender-company macros: 3 militia platoons + 2 technicals each) north to south behind the ring road, the reserve company east of the river, mortars + ZU-23 + Stinger / Igla on the hill, 2 drone teams, roadblocks (concrete blocks + cars) on the three ring-road crossings with MG nests behind sandbags, AT teams, two outposts; 200 civilians on the streets of the west belt and the old town + 6 parked cars. Visibility 5 km, 10:00 (daylight). The scripted top is intent only: phase lines PL A-D, two sectors, the objectives (seize the town hall, A / B Coy reach PL B), the defenders take positions at 0 s, A Coy attacks to PL B at 5 min, B Coy at 8; a company that reached PL B goes on to PL C (else at 15 / 18 min); the 2nd wave (macro) enters at 20 and attacks; the reserve counterattacks when the attacker holds the town hall (else at 28); the end when the town hall is held (else at 45). Recording is the cluster default (ON). Judge (60 s): every entity Active on every node, the defenders on their positions, the recorder writing, no fault. Check: the rail CityBattleSkeletonTests (Hrot.ClusterRunner.Integration.Tests); generated by scripts/city_battle_scenario.py.
